👮 **Wachiman** · review of the whole pull request, at `b12d760`: all 47 files reviewed.

7 finding(s): 2 to fix, 5 to consider; 7 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Risk map

**Medium.**

- `public-contract` · `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/prepare-path.ts:13` — preparePath now returns /export/... URLs, which every existing entry point that exports a copy uses. The old /prepare routes redirect there.

**Needs a person:**

- `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:71` (`tradeoff`) — Email reuses the Balanced preset, so a chat copy shows Ready on the Email card, and pressing Export there opens the chat copy instead of making a new one. Someone has to decide whether that is acceptable.

**Read first:** `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/prepare-path.ts`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/prepare/destination-detail.tsx`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/prepare/prepare-page.tsx`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-stage.tsx`.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 6.** I reviewed all 13 files in part 1 and found nothing to flag. The routes, the redirect from the old Prepare URLs, the Email destination, the explicit destination passed to usePrepareCopy, and the global key handlers on the Export screen all hold up against the code they call. One question stays open: nothing bounds probeSource, so if it never settles the screen stays on "Reading…" with no timeout. That behaviour is unchanged from Prepare. Separately, refresh() can reject after an import, in which case Export never opens on the new video; that code sits in use-prepare-import.ts, which this PR doesn't change.

**Batch 2 of 6.** I reviewed all five files in part 2 and have two findings.

1. **Library file drops (fix, medium confidence):** the Library no longer mounts the window-wide drop handler, and I found no navigation guard anywhere else. A file dropped on the Library may fall through to Electron's default and replace the app with the file. That contradicts step 12 of the PR's test plan, which says the drop does nothing.
2. **Recent exports labels (consider):** an Email export shows the Email logo while it runs, then Slack · Discord once it finishes, because finished rows take their destination from the preset alone.

Nothing else stood out. ExportStage, VideoPicker and the deleted DestinationDetail are consistent with the destinations model and the new strings.

**Batch 3 of 6.** I found one optional point in this part (a "consider") and nothing to block or fix.

- **What's in the part:** the old Prepare page components are deleted, the drop-zone test is ported to `useFileDrop` alone, `destinations.test.ts` covers the new email destination (which shares chat's `balanced` preset), and the rail badge moves from the Library item to the new Export item.
- **Deletions are clean:** nothing in the repository still imports the removed files.
- **Tests hold up:** the ported drop test and the destinations test match the hook and module code.
- **Translations are in place:** the `export.railBadge` key exists in both message files.
- **The one point:** the badge's new "export running" +1 doesn't follow the rule used for finished copies. A finished copy whose ready card is already on screen is left out of the count, but a running export counts even while its progress card is visible, or while the user is already on Export.

**Batch 4 of 6.** I found one problem in this part. Library no longer mounts the window-wide drop guard; only Export does. Nothing else intercepts a file dropped on Library, so Electron should load the file in the window and the app UI disappears. The new Library test checks only that no import happens, so it passes in that case. The new Export tests match how `export-page.tsx` behaves. The library-detail test changes only swap /prepare routes for /export.

**Batch 5 of 6.** I found no defects in part 5 of 6, only two optional test suggestions.

**Stylesheets.** Every design variable the new and changed export stylesheets use is defined. Most live in `packages/tokens/css/tokens.css`; the two colour tones are in the app's own `assets/base.css`.

**Deleted Prepare tests.** Almost every scenario from the deleted `prepare-page.test.tsx` has a counterpart in the new `export-page.test.tsx`: dropping files, rejecting a non-video, Enter to start, one export at a time, an unreadable file, screenshots, existing copies and unexported edits. The tests whose behaviour changed were rewritten for the new screen, for example an unknown `?to=` now picks nothing.

**Sidebar tests** (both "consider"):
- The test named "active on Export with and without a video" only checks the URL with a video. Checking `/export` as well, or renaming the test, would match its name.
- The badge now also counts an export that is still running, and no test covers that.

**Batch 6 of 6.** Part 6 holds the route constants, the window-size test, the Export stylesheets, the CSS and i18n keys the change removes, and the backlog doc. Every class the new Export stylesheets define (export-stage, recent-exports, video-picker) matches a `styles.*` reference in its component, and the size bar's new `data-tone` values (`fits`/`over`/`lighter`/`not-lighter`) match `export-stage.tsx:307`. Nothing in the repository still uses the removed i18n keys (`library.importVideo`, `importing`, `importDrop*`, `prepare.prepareAVideo`). The new `export` and `prepare.*Email` keys are present in both en and es and are used. `routes.ts` still has no value imports, so the preload rule holds. The backlog doc's claims match the code where I checked them, including that opening Export or the Library clears the finished copies from the badge (`sidebar.tsx:107-120`). The only finding is a stale comment left in `library-page.module.css` after the `.importZone` rule was removed.

<details><summary>What the change connects to (11 closed, 3 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Open: the reviewer could not close these**
- Probe the picked recording; show Reading… until it is ready, and on error show a toast and redirect to /export (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:92`) — Does probeSource carry its own timeout? Files that would answer it: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/probe-source.ts`.
- Library stops handling window-wide file drops (useFileDrop/useImportVideos removed) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.tsx:53`) — Does the main process or shell block navigation on file drop anywhere? A search for will-navigate found nothing. Files that would answer it: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell`.
- New route constants `export` (/export/:assetId) and `exportNew` (/export); `prepare`/`prepareNew` kept as legacy redirects (`apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/routes.ts:17-24`) — Whether the redirect in router.tsx (another part) keeps `?to=` for both legacy routes was not read in this part. Files that would answer it: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/app/router.tsx`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/prepare-path.ts`.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**
- A file is dropped on the window, or Browse files is used, on Export: it is imported and Export opens on it with the current destination (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:85`) — The page navigates to exportPath(first, to), and a toast names any extra files (use-prepare-import.ts:48-49). If it fails: If refresh() rejects, the .then navigation never runs and the import is left in the Library with no visible step. This code is unchanged, in use-prepare-import.ts:48. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:42-56`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:77-88`.
- Document-wide Enter and arrow keys export or move the destination selection (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:277`) — Enter starts copy.start or opens the existing copy. The arrows select the next card, and focus follows it when focus was on a card. If it fails: When an export is already running, copy.start shows the busy toast (use-prepare-copy.ts:99-101). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:356-386`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/video-picker.tsx:68-90`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:97-101`.
- The Email destination shares chat's balanced preset (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:71`) — Both cards show Ready for a balanced copy. The progress card receives destination 'email' explicitly. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:102-107`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:119`.
- Recent exports reads the export runner's running job and its progress fraction (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/recent-exports.tsx:34-62`) — A progress row with a percentage; finished rows that open the copy. If it fails: The finished-row destination comes from the preset alone, so an Email copy appears as chat once done. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:59`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:102-107`.
- GitHub size bar is scaled against GITHUB_FREE_LIMIT_BYTES (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-stage.tsx:295-307`) — The bar shows 'fits the 10 MB limit' or 'over' against a 10 MB scale. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-presets.ts:311`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-presets.ts:323`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:202-203`.
- Rail Export item badge: running export (+1) plus unannounced finished copies; opening /export or /library announces (clears) them (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:111-123`) — The badge and badgeLabel (export.railBadge, present in en.json:946 and es.json:946) move from Library to the Export item. The count is (status==='exporting' ? 1 : 0) plus the unannounced copies. If it fails: The state is in memory (ready-copies.ts:14), so a relaunch starts at 0. announceReadyCopies returns early when everything is already announced, so the effect re-running on `copies` cannot loop. When… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:111-123`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:55-75`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:26`, `packages/i18n/messages/en.json:946`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/routes.ts:20`.
- Removal of PreparePage, DestinationList, PrepareDropZone and ImportDropZone test; drop handling now through useFileDrop/usePrepareImport on the Export page (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.test.tsx:1-73`) — The new test asserts the same depth-counter, preventDefault and unmount behaviour against useFileDrop's window listeners. The zone-specific assertions (text, click, disabled) are dropped along with the component. If it fails: No dangling imports of the removed modules remain: a grep found no references to prepare-page, destination-list, prepare-drop-zone or ImportDropZone. isPrimaryEnter is re-declared in export-page.tsx:… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:16-61`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:375`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:4`.
- A file from the OS is dropped on the Library (or any screen other than Export) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.test.tsx:80`) — The test checks only that importVideoFiles is not called. In Electron, a drop that nothing handles navigates the window to the file. If it fails: The window loads the dropped file and the app UI is gone. I found no will-navigate guard in main. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:8-11`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:40-47`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:55`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:400`.
- An old /prepare URL redirects to /export, keeping ?to= (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:374`) — The Export screen opens with the destination from ?to=. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:168-173`.
- The source file cannot be read: a toast, then the screen goes to /export (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:329`) — A toast and the empty Export screen. If it fails: The failure is visible: the toast says the file could not be read. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:95-99`.
- Opening Export (/export or /export/:assetId) or the Library clears the Export rail badge's finished copies (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:117`) — The Export rail item loses its count, and the Library keeps pointing at the copies until each one is opened (sidebar.test.tsx:53-56). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:111-123`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.test.tsx:44-64`.

</details>
